This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail relating to Crime No.380/2023 registered at Police Station Vijay Nagar District Indore (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 323, 294, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.text: Police Station Vijay Nagar District Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2/ As per the prosecution story, complainant Mahima has made a written report at police station Vijay Nagar by stating that employees of HYG Marketing Pvt. Ltd. company namely Ankit Jat, Ajay Malviya, applicant Ajay Jat cheated her by luring her to earn handsome money with small investment.
When she asked to back her money, the present applicant alongwith other co-accused persons beaten her friend Mithun and committed cheating with them.
Accordingly, a case has been registered against the present applicant also.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant contended that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this offence.
There is no legal evidence available on record to connect the applicant with the aforementioned offence.
He is not owner of the said company, he is the only an employee of the said company.
None of single rupee of amount was taken by present applicant.
The complainant continuously blackmailing present applicant and other co-accused persons to fulfill their illegal money demand.
There is no seizure from present applicant.
He is permanent resident of District Indore.
Final conclusion of trial shall take sufficient long time.

Under the above circumstances,
prayer for grant of anticipatory bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.

4/ Per-contra, learned counsel for the respondent " State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection by submitting that about 15-16 other persons also made complaint against the applicant and other co-accused persons for such type of cheating, therefore, present applicant does not deserve for bail.
5/ Counsel for objector also opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
6/ Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case dairy.

7/ Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by both the parties,
nature of allegation and also taking note of the fact that named FIR has been lodged against the present applicant, including the complainant, other 15-16 persons also made written complaint against the applicant and other co-accused persons for such type of fraud, investigation is going on,
in view of the evidence available on record, this court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to applicant.
8/ Hence, this anticipatory bail application filed by applicant under section 438 Cr.P.C. is hereby rejected.
Certified copy as per rules.
